description: Reads a PageSpeed Insights result without using a test: the latest finished test of the project (or of url), or a given runId (for example one run_seo_test or a Fix with AI request named). Returns scores, Core Web Vitals and the top failed checks with a few affected items. Pass auditId (such as image-alt or render-blocking-resources) for one check's description and all its items.

auditId.description: One failed check's id from failedAudits, for its full detail

runId.description: A test's runId; omit for the latest finished test

url.description: Public address of the live page, e.g. https://example.com/pricing (not the Xodia preview)

name: get_seo_report
title: Get SEO report
